function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

message.content:
Here’s a quick guide to help you find a place to order cake—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty shop, or a convenient delivery service.

---

## 1️⃣ Local Bakeries & Specialty Shops  
These places often offer fresh, made‑to‑order cakes and can accommodate custom designs.

| Shop | What Makes Them Stand Out | Typical Delivery Options |
|------|--------------------------|--------------------------|
| **Magnolia Bakery** | Classic American pastries & signature cupcakes. | In‑store pickup; some locations partner with delivery apps. |
| **Sprinkles Cupcakes** | Instagram‑ready cupcakes & seasonal flavors. | In‑store pickup; some locations use delivery partners. |
| **Baker & Spice** | Organic, gluten‑free, and vegan options. | In‑store pickup; some offer curbside. |
| **Local Artisan Bakeries** | Custom designs, seasonal themes, and unique flavor combos. | Many accept phone orders for pickup or local delivery. |

> **Tip:** Call ahead or check their website for “specialty” or “custom” cake options. Some bakeries also allow you to design your own cake online.

---

## 2️⃣ Online Delivery Platforms  
If you want convenience and a wide selection, try one of these popular services:

| Platform | How It Works | Pros | Cons |
|----------|--------------|------|------|
| **Uber Eats** | Browse local restaurants & bakeries → add to cart → pay online. | Fast delivery, real‑time tracking. | Delivery fees + tip. |
| **DoorDash** | Similar to Uber Eats; many local bakeries list here. | Often offers promo codes. | Delivery fee + tip. |
| **Postmates** | Good for specialty items & local shops. | Flexible pickup/delivery. | Delivery fee + tip. |
| **Instacart** | Order from grocery stores that carry pre‑made cakes. | Same‑day delivery. | Delivery fee + tip. |
| **Amazon Fresh** | Fresh groceries & bakery items delivered. | Same‑day delivery in select areas. | Delivery fee + tip. |

> **Pro Tip:** Look for “Bakery” or “Dessert” categories on these apps. Many have filters for “Custom Cakes” or “Birthday Cakes.”

---

## 3️⃣ Direct Online Cake Shops  
These sites specialize in cakes and often ship nationwide.

| Site | Highlights | Shipping |
|------|------------|----------|
| **Goldbelly** | Curated selection from famous U.S. bakeries. | Nationwide shipping (often overnight). |
| **Cake Delivery** | Custom cakes shipped directly to your door. | Nationwide shipping. |
| **Etsy** | Handmade cakes from independent bakers. | Varies by seller. |
| **Local Bakery Websites** | Many local shops now offer online ordering & delivery. | Usually local or regional. |

> **Note:** Shipping costs can be high for large cakes. Check the estimated delivery time and packaging details.

---

## 4️⃣ Tips for Ordering a Cake

| Question | Why It Matters | How to Find the Answer |
|----------|----------------|------------------------|
| **What’s the occasion?** | Helps choose size, theme, and flavor. | Birthday, wedding, corporate event, etc. |
| **How many people?** | Determines cake size & quantity. | Estimate 8–10 slices per person. |
| **Any dietary restrictions?** | Gluten‑free, vegan, nut‑free, etc. | Ask the baker or check product labels. |
| **Do you need a custom design?** | Some bakeries charge extra for intricate designs. | Discuss with the baker or use online design tools. |
| **When do you need it?** | Delivery windows vary. | Confirm cut‑off times for same‑day delivery. |
| **What’s your budget?** | Prices range widely. | Compare prices across platforms. |

---

## 5️⃣ Quick Order Checklist

1. **Choose a platform** (local bakery, delivery app, or direct shop).  
2. **Select cake size & flavor** (or customize).  
3. **Add any special instructions** (e.g., “no nuts,” “birthday theme”).  
4. **Confirm delivery address & time**.  
5. **Pay online** (most platforms accept credit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, etc.).  
6. **Track the order** (real‑time updates on most apps).  

---

### Need a Specific Recommendation?

If you let me know your city or zip code, I can suggest a few top-rated local bakeries or delivery partners that are known for great cakes in your area. Happy cake hunting! 🍰
